rationale: iter-1 default ResNet (8 blocks, c=48, GroupNorm, ReLU; 0.67M params). Timed out at 4/8 epochs in 8min. No down/up-sampling means full-resolution compute at 1152x736 proj-domain is ~3x slower per epoch than the U-Net. Next: shrink to c=32 / 6 blocks to fit the 5-min budget. Cites Sidky 2022 sec III where the spread of arch families suggests this class is worth trying.

iter-2: ResNet 6 blocks, c=32, GroupNorm, ReLU. Val SSIM 0.6583 / headroom 0.5831 — beats main agent's iter-16 best (UNet+BF: 0.6537/0.5760). 0.225M params (half of UNet+BF), no down/up-sampling, full-res local refinement. Cites Sidky 2022 sec III: residual/variational networks are one of the top-team families.
iter-3: depth 6 -> 8 blocks at c=32. 6 blocks completed in 444s; 33% extra depth pushed past the 8-min wall. Timeout at epoch 6/8. Depth ceiling at this width is 6 blocks. Reverting to iter-2.

iter-4: ReLU -> Swish (SiLU). Landed on Quadro RTX 5000 (slower GPU) and timed out at epoch 6/8. Cluster is heterogeneous (q5000 vs q6000 vs q8000); residual-stack timing varies by ~30% across GPU types. Need either GPU exclusion or smaller model for robustness.

iter-5: ReLU -> Swish (SiLU). Landed on Quadro RTX 5000 again because the /tmp helper passed --exclude=lme171 on the cmdline, which overrode the in-script exclude. Training finished but validation OOMed at 16GB VRAM (val_n=100 forwarded full-res through 1152x736). Two fixes: (a) drop the cmdline override (helper updated), (b) chunked validation in solver for robustness.

iter-6: infra — added chunked validation (val_chunk=8) so the full-res residual stack fits on 16GB Q5000 VRAM. SSIM 0.6583 -> 0.6575 (within FP noise), headroom 0.5831 -> 0.5861 (+0.5% from FP determinism in chunked sums). Same model as iter-2, just safer validation. Keep so future iters land on this baseline.

iter-7: ReLU -> Swish (SiLU). SSIM 0.6575 -> 0.6535 (-0.6%), headroom 0.5861 -> 0.5805 (-1.0%). Swish slightly worse than ReLU for this residual stack; the noise-prediction (residual head zeroed) likely benefits from the sparse 0-output property of ReLU. Reverting.

iter-8: c=32 -> c=40 (params 0.225M -> 0.350M, +55%). SSIM 0.6575 -> 0.6408 (-2.5%), headroom 0.5861 -> 0.5598 (-4.5%). Substantial regression. Wider on 400-phantom subset overfits, mirroring the main agent's iter-3 finding that U-Net c>=24 hurts on this data budget. c=32 confirmed as residual-stack width sweet spot.
